raw_text: `entities/` clients; `models/` API types; `pkg/` utilities; `examples/` (start `examples/mass-demo-generator`); `docs/`; `scripts/`; root `Makefile`, `go.mod`, `.env.example`, `PLAN.md`. Go 1.24.x. Commands: `make set-env`; `make test`/`make test-fast`; `make coverage`; `make lint`/`make fmt`/`make tidy`; `make verify-sdk`; `go build ./...`; `go test -v ./path/to/file_test.go`; `go test -v ./path/to/package -run TestName`; `make docs`; `make demo-data`; `cd examples/mass-demo-generator && DEMO_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 go run main.go --org-locale=br --patterns=false`; `make godoc` (http://localhost:6060). No panics in library code. Write unit tests for all new code (minimum 80% coverage). Never commit secrets. Configure via `.env` (copy from `.env.example`). Run `make fmt lint test verify-sdk` before opening a PR. Ensure idempotent requests by setting `X-Idempotency` header via context when needed. Keep changes minimal and scoped; update `PLAN.md` when you finish milestones or add flags/patterns. Touch only relevant packages; follow existing folder conventions.
